name: KUKA Robot Language
summary: Pascal-like robot programming language of KUKA KRC controllers: .src/.dat file pairs hold routines and their persistent data, with typed declarations (FRAME, POS, E6POS), motion statements PTP, LIN and CIRC, interrupts, triggers and submit interpreter programs.

level_notes.1: KUKA System Software programming manuals are distributed to customers (registration).
level_notes.0: Controller runtime is proprietary; open KRL code exists in ROS-Industrial drivers.
level_notes.2: Open material is mainly community notes.

resources.title: ROS-Industrial KUKA RSI interface KRL programs
